about: Golden set for the PersonalListenerAgent relevance pre-gate. Each case is one 30 s window, the participant's profile, and a human label: would this participant want a note from it? 'You' is the participant. Labels are the maintainer's judgement, written before any model was run against them. ADR-0039: 'never_record_topics' (the company's ground rules) makes a window mainly about one of them not relevant whatever else it holds; 'commitments' labels how many promises 'You' made in the window (C3; promises by anyone else do not count).

cases.window:
Participant 1: The billing migration has to land before Friday's release.
You: I'll take the migration, I know that schema.
Participant 1: Great, so you own it, Friday.

Participant 1: The usage query is doing a sequential scan on every request.
